info.name: TMO API
info.description:
The Mortgage Office API provides resources for querying and modifying your company databases. The API uses JSON web service semantics. Each web service implements the business processes as defined in this API documentation. ## Authentication All API requests require the following headers: - `Token`: Your API token (assigned by Applied Business Software) - `Database`: The name of your company database Environments: - US: [https://api.themortgageoffice.com](https://api.themortgageoffice.com) - Canada: [https://api-ca.themortgageoffice.com](https://api-ca.themortgageoffice.com) - Australia: [https://api-aus.themortgageoffice.com](https://api-aus.themortgageoffice.com) Sandbox Access: - URL: [https://api.themortgageoffice.com](https://api.themortgageoffice.com) - Token: TMO - Database: API Sandbox ## Common Response Structure All API endpoints return a response with the following structure: ``` json { "Data": "string or object", "ErrorMessage": "string", "ErrorNumber": 0, "Status": 0 } ``` ## Response Fields | Field | Type | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | Data | string or object | The response data, which varies depending on the endpoint | | ErrorMessage | string | Error message, if any | | ErrorNumber | integer | Error number | | Status | integer | Status of the request | # Release Notes | **Release Notes** | | --- | | **July 16, 2025**
Loan Servicing:
For Commercial, Construction, and Line of Credit loans, API calls now use BilledToDate instead of PaidToDate. The NewLoan and UpdateLoan endpoints remain backward compatible by using PaidToDate if BilledToDate is not provided. GetLoan no longer returns PaidToDate for these loan types, so any integrations must be updated to reference BilledToDate:
\- Terms.Commercial.BilledToDate for Commercial loans
\- Terms.LOC_BilledToDate for Lines of Credit
\- Terms.CON_BilledToDate for Construction loans

Loan Origination:
NewLoan and UpdateLoan endpoints now support Notes field | | **June 2, 2025**
Mortgage Pools: Introducing a set of endpoints allowing access to Shares Owned mortgage pools | | **March 26, 2025**
Loan Servicing: GetLoanTrustLedger has been updated to return category for each transaction. The category can be "Impound" or "Reserve"

Loan Servicing: additional fields were added to NewLoan and UpdateLoan endpoints.

Loan Servicing: GetVendor, GetVendors and GetVendorsByTimestamp endpoints have been addeed to return all Vendor details including custom fields.

Loan Servicing: GetCheckRegister has been updated to return ChkGroupRecID | | **January 9, 2025**
Loan Servicing: getLenders and GetLendersByTimestamp endpoints now support pagination using PageSize and Offset request header.

Loan Servicing: Escrow Voucher API has been updated to include following fields:
\- VoucherType
\- PropertyRecID
\- InsuranceRecID

Loan Servicing: NewLoan, GetLoan and UpdateLoan endpoints has been modified to include following fields in Co-Borrower details:
\- DeliveryOptions
\- CCR_AddressIndicator
\- CCR_ResidenceCode
\- AssociatedBorrower
\- Title
\- PercentOwnership
\- AuthorizedSigner
\- LegalStructureType | | **December 2, 2024**
Loan Servicing: Loan API endpoints were updated to support additional terms fields.
Construction:
\- Interest on Available Funds
\- Interest on Available Funds - Method
\- Interest on Available Funds - the rate to use when Fixed Rate or Modifier is selected.
\- Completion Date
\- Construction Loan Amount
\- Contractor License No.
\- RecID of construction contractor vendor
\- Joint Checks
\- Project Description
\- Project Sq. Ft.
\- Revolving
Penalties:
\- DefaultRateUse

Loan Servicing: getLenders and getLendersByTimestamp endpoints now support pagination using Offset and PageSize headers. | | **October 18, 2024**
Loan Servicing: Updated LoanAdjustment endpoint to allow posting non-cash historical adjustments to a loan.

Loan Servicing: Following endpoint have been updated to include construction trust balance:
\- GetLoan
\- GetLoans
\- GetLoansByTimestamp | | **October 7, 2024**
Loan servicing API has been updated to include flood zone field for collaterals. GetLoanProperties endpoint now returns flood zone for each property. ​NewProperty and UpdateProperty endpoints now accept FloodZone field.

Loan Origination API: Added property encumbrance information to collateral details in the following endpoints:
\- GetLoan
\- NewLoan
\- NewCollateral
\- UpdateCollateral
The endpoints now support multiple encumbrances per collateral property. |

item.name: Loan Origination
Loan Application

request.description:
This API allows users to create a new loan application by sending a POST request to the specified endpoint. The request body should include applicant details, loan information, and optional fields such as whether to send a portal invite. Upon successful execution, a reference number and borrower portal link are provided in the response.

### Request Body

| **Field Name** | **Data Type** | **Description** | **Enum Values** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Email` | string | Required. The email of the applicant. | \- |
| `FullName` | string | Required. The full name of the applicant. | \- |
| `IsSendPortalInvite` | Boolean | Indicates if a portal invite should be sent. | \- |
| `IsCreateNewLoanFromLoanApplication` | Boolean | Indicates if a new loan should be created. | \- |
| `DocId` | string | The document ID associated with the application. You can use GetProducts to retrieve all loan products available. | \- |
| `LoanNumber` | string | The loan number for the application. | \- |
| `LoanOfficer` | string | The loan officer assigned to the application. | \- |
| `UserAccess` | string | User access information. | \- |
| `LoanStatus` | string | Required. The current status of the loan application. | Accepted, Rejected, Pending |
| `TrustAccountClientName` | string | The client name associated with the trust account. | \- |
| `Fields` | array | Array of custom fields as key-value pairs. | \- |
| `Fields`\[\].`Key` | string | The unique identifier for the custom field. | \- |
| `Fields`\[\].`Value` | string | The value for the custom field. | \- |

### Response

- `Data` (string): The response data containing `RecId`, Loan Application Reference Number, Borrower Portal Link, Email to Applicant, Create New Loan from New Loan Application, Loan Number  
    **LoanApplicationReferenceNumber can be used in the GetLoanApplication API to fetch th details of a particular loan application.**
    
- `ErrorMessage` (string): Error message, if any.
    
- `ErrorNumber` (integer): Error number.
    
- `Status` (integer): Status of the request.
    

The response returns a status code of 200 upon successful execution.

request.description:
The GetLoanApplication API allows users to retrieve a specific loan application's details by sending an HTTP GET request with the application reference number. The response contains the loan application data, including metadata such as the application number, date applied, and any custom fields added during the loan application process.

### **Usage Notes**

1. The `LoanApplicationReferenceNumber` is provided in the response of the NewLoanApplication API when a new application is successfully created.
    
2. Custom fields in the `Fields` array may vary based on the specific data collected during the application process.
    

| **Field Name** | Data Type | **Description** | **Enum Values** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Data` | object | The loan application detail object. | \- |
| `Data`.`ApplicationNumber` | string | The application number. | \- |
| `Data`.`DateApplied` | string | The date and time the application was created. | \- |
| `Data`.`Email` | string | The email of the applicant. | \- |
| Data.Fields | array | Array of custom fields as key-value pairs. | \- |
| `Data`.`Fields`\[\].`Key` | string | The unique identifier for the custom field. | \- |
| `Data`.`Fields`\[\].`Value` | string | The value for the custom field. | \- |
| `ErrorMessage` | string | The error message, if any. | \- |
| `ErrorNumber` | integer | The error number associated with the request. | \- |
| `Status` | integer | The status of the request. | \- |

request.description:
This API enables users to update an existing loan application by making a POST request with the application number and updated details. The request body should contain new values for the fields that need updating. Upon successful execution, the API returns the updated loan application details. ### **Usage Notes** 1. The `ApplicationNumber` must correspond to an existing loan application in the system. This is the same as the Loan Application Reference Number Returned in the NewLoanApplication API response upon successful creation of a loan application. ### Response | **Field Name** | **Data Type** | **Description** | Enum value | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `ApplicationNumber` | string | Required. Accepted =1 Declined =2
Funded = 3 | | `Fields`\[\].`Key` | String | The unique identifier for the custom field. | \- | | `Fields`\[\].`Value` | String | The value for the custom field. | \- | - `Data` (string): Response Data (Loan application detail object) - `ErrorMessage` (string): Error message, if any - `ErrorNumber` (integer): Error number - `Status` (integer): Status of the request The response returns a status code of 200 upon successful execution.

item.description: This folder contains documentation for APIs to manage loan application information. These APIs enable comprehensive loan application operations, allowing you to create, retrieve, and update application details efficiently. ## **API Descriptions** - **NewLoanApplication** - Purpose: Creates a new loan application in the system. - Key Feature: Returns a unique Loan Application Reference Number and optionally sends a portal invite to the applicant. - Use Case: Initiating a new loan application process for a potential borrower. - **GetLoanApplication** - Purpose: Retrieves detailed information about a specific loan application. - Key Feature: Returns comprehensive application data, including custom fields and application status. - Use Case: Reviewing or verifying the details of an existing loan application. - **UpdateLoanApplication** - Purpose: Modifies an existing loan application's details in the system. - Key Feature: Allows updating of various application attributes such as applicant information, loan officer, and custom fields. - Use Case: Updating application information as the loan process progresses or correcting existing data. ## **Key Concepts** - **Loan Application Reference Number / Application Number**: A unique identifier assigned to each loan application, used across all three APIs to identify specific applications. - **Custom Fields**: Flexible key-value pairs that allow for capturing and managing application-specific data across all APIs. ## **API Interactions** - Use NewLoanApplication to create a new loan application and obtain a Loan Application Reference Number. - Use the Loan Application Reference Number from NewLoanApplication to retrieve application details with GetLoanApplication. - Use UpdateLoanApplication with the Application Number (same as Loan Application Reference Number) to modify existing application records, including custom fields and application status.

request.description:
The GetLoans endpoint retrieves a list of loans from Loan Origination system. This endpoint provides essential information about each loan, including loan details, borrower information, and important dates. ### Usage Notes - The `LoanNumber` field is crucial for retrieving detailed information about a specific loan using the GetLoan endpoint. - Use the `SysTimeStamp` field to filter loans based on recent updates. ### Response Fields | Field Name | Description | Data Type | Enum Values | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **AmortTerm** | Amortization term (in months) | Integer, positive value,
Nullable | \- | | **AmortType** | Type of amortization | ENUM | 0 - Fully Amortized Mortgage,
1 - Interest Only Mortgage
2 - Other | | **ApplicationDate** | Date when the application was submitted | String | \- | | **Borrowers** | Information about the borrowers | Nullable, object | \- | | **BrokerFeeFlat** | Flat broker fee for Our origination charge | Decimal, non-negative | \- | | **BrokerFeePct** | Broker fee percentage for Mtg Broker Fee | Decimal, non-negative | \- | | **CalculateFinalPayment** | Flag to determine if the final payment schedule is calculated | Boolean, "True" or "False" | \- | | **Categories** | Categories associated with the loan | String, nullable | \- | | **Collaterals** | Collateral details | Nullable, object | \- | | **DailyRateBasis** | Basis for calculating the daily rate | Integer (360 or 365) | \- | | **DateLoanClosed** | Date when the loan was closed | Date format (MM/DD/YYYY), nullable | \- | | **DateLoanCreated** | Date when the File Created | Date format (MM/DD/YYYY) | \- | | **EscrowNumber** | Number of the escrow account for loan information | String, nullable | \- | | **ExpectedClosingDate** | Expected date for closing in General Information | Date format (MM/DD/YYYY), nullable | \- | | **FinalActionDate** | Date of the final action taken for loan | Date format (MM/DD/YYYY), nullable | \- | | **FinalActionTaken** | Indicator to take final action for the loan through dropdown selection. | Integer, 0 to 8 | \- | | **FirstPaymentDate** | Date of the first payment | Date format (MM/DD/YYYY), nullable | \- | | **FundingDate** | Date when the loan was funded | Date format (MM/DD/YYYY), nullable | \- | | **IsLocked** | Indicates if the loan is locked | Boolean, "True" or "False" | \- | | **IsStepRate** | Indicates if the loan has a step rate | Boolean, "True" or "False" | \- | | **IsTemplate** | Indicates if the loan is a template | Boolean, "True" or "False" | \- | | **LoanAmount** | Amount for loan | Decimal, positive value | \- | | **LoanNumber** | Unique identifier for the loan.
**This should be used in GetLoan to get more details about a particular loan** | String, nullable | \- | | **LoanOfficer** | Name of the loan officer | String, nullable | \- | | **LoanStatus** | Current status of the loan | String | | | **MaturityDate** | Date when the loan matures | Date format (MM/DD/YYYY), nullable | \- | | **NoteRate** | Interest rate on the loan | Decimal | \- | | **OddFirstPeriodHandling** | Indicator of odd first period handling | Integer, 0 to 2 | 0 - None,
1 - PrepaidInterest
2 - OddFirstPayment | | **PPY** | Payments per year | Integer | \- | | **PrepaidPayments** | Number of prepaid payments | Integer, non-negative | \- | | **RecID** | Unique record to identify a loan
**This is also referred to as LoanRecId in other APIs like NewCollateral** | String | \- | | **DocID** | Identify the Products for loan | String | | | **ShortName** | Short name or description for the loan | String | \- | | **SoldRate** | Sold interest rate | Decimal | \- | | **Term** | Term of the loan (in months) | Integer, positive value | \- | | **SysTimeStamp** | Records the exact date and time of an event.
**This indicates when a Loan object was last updated. This can be used to filter loans based on recent updates.** | Date and time format | \- |

request.description:
The GetLoansByTimestamp endpoint allows you to retrieve loan details from The Mortgage Office (TMO) system based on a specified date range. This endpoint is useful for getting updates or new loans created within a particular time frame.

The endpoint accepts date and time for from and to dates. For example: 11-26-2024 17:00. If time is omitted then 00:00 will be used for filter.

**Refer to GetLoans API call for details about the payload and field descriptions.**

request.description:
The **DeleteLoan** endpoint allows you to delete an existing loan from the Loan Origination by making an HTTP DELETE request. This endpoint requires the loan number to identify which loan should be deleted.

### Request URL

`DELETE https://{{Base URL}}/LOS.svc/DeleteLoan/{{Loan Number}}`

### Path Variable

- `Loan Number`: Required. The unique identifier for the loan that you wish to delete.
    

### Expected Response

Upon successful execution, the response will return a status code of `200`. However, if there is an error with the request, you may receive a `400` status code along with a JSON response that includes the following fields:

| Field Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Data` | Contains data related to the request (null if no data) |
| `ErrorMessage` | Message detailing the error (if any) |
| `ErrorNumber` | Numeric code representing the error (0 if no error) |
| `Status` | Status code of the operation (0 if no error) |

### Usage Notes

- Ensure that the `Loan Number` is valid and corresponds to an existing loan in the system. This number should be obtained from a previous GetLoans API call.
    
- The request does not require a body; simply specify the loan number in the URL.
    

### Example Response

``` json
{
  "Data": null,
  "ErrorMessage": "",
  "ErrorNumber": 0,
  "Status": 0
}

 ```

item.description: This folder contains documentation for five essential APIs provided by The Mortgage Office (TMO) system. These APIs enable comprehensive loan management operations, allowing you to retrieve, create, and update loan information efficiently. ## API Descriptions 1. **GetLoans** - Purpose: Retrieves a list of all loans in the system. - Key Feature: Returns basic information for each loan, including LoanNumber and SysTimeStamp. - Use Case: Ideal for getting an overview of the entire loan portfolio. 2. **GetLoan** - Purpose: Fetches detailed information about a specific loan. - Key Feature: Uses LoanNumber to retrieve comprehensive loan details. - Use Case: Used when in-depth information about a particular loan is needed. 3. **GetLoansByTimestamp** - Purpose: Retrieves loans created or updated within a specified date range. - Key Feature: Uses SysTimeStamp to filter loans, returning LoanNumber and SysTimeStamp for each. - Use Case: Useful for synchronization, auditing, or tracking recent changes. 4. **NewLoan** - Purpose: Creates a new loan in the system. - Key Feature: Generates a new LoanNumber and SysTimeStamp for the created loan. - Use Case: Used when originating a new loan in the system. 5. **UpdateLoan** - Purpose: Modifies existing loan information. - Key Feature: Uses LoanNumber to identify the loan and updates its SysTimeStamp. - Use Case: Employed when loan details need to be changed or updated. ## Key Concepts - **LoanNumber**: A unique identifier for each loan, used across APIs to reference specific loans. - **SysTimeStamp**: Tracks when a loan was last updated, crucial for the GetLoansByTimestamp API and monitoring changes. ## API Interactions - Use GetLoans or GetLoansByTimestamp to retrieve lists of loans. - Use the LoanNumber from these lists to fetch specific loan details with GetLoan. - Create new loans with NewLoan, generating new LoanNumbers and SysTimeStamps. - Modify existing loans using UpdateLoan, which updates the loan's SysTimeStamp. These APIs work together to provide a complete solution for managing loans throughout their lifecycle, from creation to ongoing updates and retrieval.

request.description:
This endpoint allows you to add new loan funding details to the system. You need to provide a JSON payload with relevant information such as the account, date of deposit, amount funded, and legal vesting details. This payload is an array i.e you can add multiple loan fundings in one call. But please note that having a faulty payload for even one object will result in the entire call failing. This functionality is essential for recording new funding events and ensuring the loan records are up-to-date. ### Usage Notes 1. The API accepts an array of loan funding objects, allowing multiple fundings to be added in a single call. 2. If any object in the array has invalid data, the entire call will fail. Ensure all data is valid before making the request. 3. The `LoanNumber` field is used to determine which loan the funding is being created against. 4. Date fields should be in the format "MM/DD/YYYY" or "12:00:00 AM" if the exact time is unknown. 5. Boolean fields should use `true` or `false` values. 6. request.description:
This endpoint enables you to update existing loan funding records in the system. By providing the `RecID` of the funding record, you can modify details such as the account, amount funded, date of deposit, and legal vesting information. This is useful for correcting or updating funding details as needed. ### Usage Notes 1. The `RecID` is required and must correspond to an existing loan funding record. It can be obtained via the GetLoanFundings API call or via the response body of the AddLoanFundings call upon successful creation of a Loan Funding against a loan. 2. Date fields should be in the format "MM/DD/YYYY". 3. Boolean fields should use `true` or `false` values. ### Request Body | Field Name | Data Type | Description | Possible Values | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `RecID` | String | Required. Unique identifier for the loan funding record.
**Can be obtained via the GetLoanFundings call in the response. Also availabale in the response payload of the AddLoanFunding call upon succesful addition of a loan funding** | 11FB9BA1B2A64583A859D94645E398D3 | | `Account` | String | Required. The account associated with the funding. | 2863 | | `Salutation` | String | Salutation (if applicable) | MR. | | `City` | String | The city of the funding record. | Signal Hill | | `DOB` | Date | Date of birth (if applicable). | 04/10/1995 | | `EmailAddress` | String | Email address (if applicable). | mail[@absnetwork.com](https://mailto:satish@absnetwork.com) | | `EmailFormat` | String | Format of the email (if applicable). | PlainText = 0

item.description: This folder contains documentation for APIs to manage loan funding information. These APIs enable comprehensive loan funding operations, allowing you to retrieve, create, and update funding details efficiently. ## API Descriptions 1. **GetLoanFundings** - Purpose: Retrieves funding details associated with a specific loan number. - Key Feature: Returns a list of funding records, including amounts, dates, and contact information. - Use Case: Reviewing all funding activities related to a particular loan. 2. **AddLoanFunding** - Purpose: Adds new loan funding details to the system. - Key Feature: Supports adding multiple funding records in a single API call. - Use Case: Recording new funding events when originating loans or adding additional funding to existing loans. 3. **UpdateLoanFunding** - Purpose: Modifies existing loan funding records in the system. - Key Feature: Allows updating of various funding attributes such as amount, deposit date, and legal vesting information. - Use Case: Correcting or updating funding details as needed to maintain accurate records. ## Key Concepts - **LoanNumber**: Identifies the loan associated with funding records in GetLoanFundings and AddLoanFunding operations. - **RecID**: A unique identifier for each funding record, used in update operations (UpdateLoanFunding API) and returned by GetLoanFundings. ## API Interactions - Use GetLoanFundings to retrieve existing funding records for a loan. - Use AddLoanFunding to create new funding records, which generates new RecIDs. - Use the RecID obtained from GetLoanFundings or AddLoanFunding to update specific funding records with UpdateLoanFunding.

request.description:
The GetLoanAttachments API retrieves all attachments associated with a specific loan account in Loan Servicing system. This API is essential for applications that need to access and manage documents and other attachments linked to a particular loan.

### Usage Notes

1. The `LoanNumber` in the URL path is required and must correspond to an existing loan in the system.
    
2. The API returns all attachments associated with the specified loan number.
    
3. The `RecID` field in each attachment object can be used in GetLoanAttachment call to obtain a single attachment.
    
4. The `SysCreatedDate` is in the format "MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS AM/PM".
    

### Response

#### Response Structure

| Field Name | Data Type | Description | Enum Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FileName` | string | The name of the attachment file. | \- |
| `Description` | string | A brief description of the attachment. | \- |
| `TabName` | string | The name of the tab where the attachment is stored. | \- |
| `DocType` | string/integer | The document type of the attachment. | `-1`: Default/Unknown |
| `Content` | string (base64) | The base64-encoded content of the attachment. | \- |
| `OwnerRecID` | string | Loan Recid for attachment |  |

#### Response

| Field Name | Data Type | Description | Enum Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Data` | string | The response data, typically the identifier of the attachment. | \- |
| `ErrorMessage` | string | Error message, if any. | \- |
| `ErrorNumber` | integer | Error number indicating the nature of the error. | \- |
| `Status` | integer | Status of the request. | `0`: Success, `-1`: Error |

This endpoint retrieves detailed information about a specific attachment using its unique `RecID`. The request requires the `RecID` of the attachment to be included in the URL. The response provides comprehensive details about the requested attachment.

### Usage Notes

1. The `RecId` in the URL path is required and must correspond to an existing attachment in the system.
    
2. The `RecId` can be obtained from the response payload of the GetLoanAttachments API call or the AddAttachment API call upon successful addition of a Loan Attachment.
    

### Response

The response payload for this API is identical to the GetLoanAttachments payload.

request.description:
This endpoint allows you to add a new attachment to a specific loan account. The request should include details about the attachment, such as the file name, description, tab name, document type, and base64-encoded content.

### **Usage Notes**

1. The `RecId` returned in the `Data` field can be used with the `GetLoanAttachment` endpoint to retrieve the newly added attachment.
    
2. The `OwnerType` field uses numeric codes to represent different entity types (e.g., 0 for Borrower, 1 for Lender).
    
3. File size cannot exceed 2GB
    

### Request Body

| Field Name | Data Type | Description | Enum Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FileName` | string | Required. The name of the attachment file. | \- |
| `Description` | string | Required. A brief description of the attachment. | \- |
| `TabName` | string | The name of the tab where the attachment is stored. | \- |
| `DocType` | string/integer | The document type of the attachment. | `-1`: Default/Unknown |
| `Content` | string (base64) | Required. The base64-encoded content of the attachment. | \- |

#### Response

| Field Name | Data Type | Description | Enum Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Data` | string | The response data, typically the identifier of the attachment. | \- |
| `ErrorMessage` | string | Error message, if any. | \- |
| `ErrorNumber` | integer | Error number indicating the nature of the error. | \- |
| `Status` | integer | Status of the request. | `0`: Success, `-1`: Error |

The response returns a status code of 200 upon successful execution.

item.description: This folder contains documentation for APIs to manage loan attachment information. These APIs enable comprehensive loan attachment operations, allowing you to retrieve, add, and access individual attachments efficiently. ## **API Descriptions** 1. **GetLoanAttachments** 1. Purpose: Retrieves all attachments associated with a specific loan number. 2. Key Feature: Returns a list of attachment records, including file names, descriptions, and unique identifiers. 3. Use Case: Reviewing all documents and files related to a particular loan. 2. **GetLoanAttachment** 1. Purpose: Fetches detailed information about a single attachment using its unique identifier. 2. Key Feature: Provides comprehensive details about a specific attachment, potentially including its content. 3. Use Case: Accessing or displaying information about a specific document or file related to a loan. 3. **AddAttachment** 1. Purpose: Adds a new attachment to a specified loan account. 2. Key Feature: Supports uploading of file content along with metadata such as file name, description, and document type. 3. Use Case: Adding new documents or files to an existing loan record. ## **Key Concepts** - **LoanNumber**: Identifies the loan associated with attachments in GetLoanAttachments and AddAttachment operations. - **RecId**: A unique identifier for each attachment, used in GetLoanAttachment operations and returned by GetLoanAttachments and AddAttachment. ## **API Interactions** - Use GetLoanAttachments to retrieve a list of all attachments for a loan, obtaining `RecId` for each attachment. - Use GetLoanAttachment with a `RecId` to fetch detailed information about a specific attachment. - Use AddAttachment to upload new attachments to a loan, which generates a new `RecId`. - The `RecId` returned by AddAttachment can be immediately used with GetLoanAttachment to verify the upload or retrieve the new attachment's details.

4. The `Employments` array can contain multiple employment records for the borrower.

request.description:
The DeleteCollateral API allows you to remove a specific collateral entry from a loan record in The Mortgage Office (TMO) system. This API is crucial for applications that need to manage the lifecycle of collateral, including the ability to remove collateral that is no longer associated with a loan.

### Usage Notes

1. The `RecId` must correspond to an existing collateral record in the system. `RecId` is found in the response of the GetLoan call under Loan->Collateral->RecId.
    
2. This operation is irreversible. Once a collateral entry is deleted, it cannot be restored without creating a new entry.
    
3. It's recommended to verify the collateral details using the GetLoan API before deletion to ensure you're removing the correct entry.

item.description: This folder contains documentation for three essential APIs provided by The Mortgage Office (TMO) system for managing collateral information associated with loans. These APIs enable comprehensive collateral management operations, allowing you to create, update, and delete collateral entries efficiently. ## API Descriptions 1. **NewCollateral** - Purpose: Adds new collateral details to an existing loan record. - Key Feature: Associates property or asset information with a loan as security. - Use Case: When originating a new loan or adding additional collateral to an existing loan. 2. **UpdateCollateral** - Purpose: Modifies existing collateral details associated with a loan record. - Key Feature: Allows updating of various collateral attributes such as address, description, and custom fields. - Use Case: When collateral information changes or needs correction. 3. **DeleteCollateral** - Purpose: Removes a specific collateral entry from a loan record. - Key Feature: Permanently deletes a collateral entry based on its unique identifier. - Use Case: When collateral is no longer associated with a loan or was added in error. ## Key Concepts - **RecID**: A unique identifier for each collateral entry, used in update and delete operations. Can be obtained from the response of a GetLoan call under Loan->Collateral->RecID - **LoanRecID**: Identifies the loan to which the collateral is associated. Can be obtained from the response of GetLoan, GetLoans, or GetLoansByTimestamp. It is also available in the response payload of NewLoan call upon succesful creation of a loan. ## API Interactions ### Creating a Collateral Against a Loan: - Use GetLoan, GetLoans or GetLoansbyTimestamp to obtain `RecId` of a Loan. - Use NewCollateral to add collateral to a loan, which generates a new RecID. ### Updating and Deleting a Collateral Against a Loan: - Get `RecId` from GetLoan call under Loan->Collateral->RecId - Use the `RecID` retrieved from GetLoan to update or delete specific collateral entries. - UpdateCollateral allows for partial updates, meaning you only need to include the fields you want to change. - DeleteCollateral permanently removes a collateral entry, so use with caution. These APIs work together to provide a complete solution for managing collateral throughout the lifecycle of a loan, from initial creation to ongoing updates and potential removal.

item.description: This folder contains documentation for APIs to manage escrow voucher information. These APIs enable comprehensive escrow voucher operations, allowing you to create, retrieve, update, and delete escrow vouchers efficiently, both individually and in bulk. ## **API Descriptions** - **POSTNewEscrowVoucher** - Purpose: Creates a new escrow voucher for a specific loan. - Key Feature: Allows specification of voucher details such as amount, pay date, frequency, and payee information. - Use Case: Setting up a new recurring payment for property taxes or insurance premiums. - **POSTNewEscrowVouchers (Bulk)** - Purpose: Creates multiple new escrow vouchers in a single operation. - Key Feature: Accepts an array of voucher details, enabling efficient batch creation. - Use Case: Setting up multiple escrow payments at once, such as when onboarding a new loan. - **GETGetEscrowVouchers** - Purpose: Retrieves all escrow vouchers associated with a specific account. - Key Feature: Returns a list of voucher records, including payment details and status information. - Use Case: Reviewing all scheduled escrow payments for a particular loan. - **POSTFindEscrowVouchers** - Purpose: Searches for escrow vouchers based on specified criteria. - Key Feature: Supports filtering by various parameters such as date range, voucher type, and loan account. - Use Case: Generating reports or auditing escrow payments across multiple loans. - **POSTUpdateEscrowVoucher** - Purpose: Updates an existing escrow voucher with new information. - Key Feature: Allows modification of voucher details such as amount, pay date, or status. - Use Case: Adjusting an escrow payment due to changes in tax assessments or insurance premiums. - **POSTUpdateEscrowVouchers (Bulk)** - Purpose: Updates multiple existing escrow vouchers in a single operation. - Key Feature: Accepts an array of voucher updates, enabling efficient batch modifications. - Use Case: Applying changes to multiple escrow payments simultaneously, such as annual adjustments. - **GETDeleteEscrowVoucher** - Purpose: Deletes a single escrow voucher from the system. - Key Feature: Removes the specified voucher using its unique identifier. - Use Case: Cancelling a specific escrow payment that is no longer required. - **POSTDeleteEscrowVouchers (Bulk)** - Purpose: Deletes multiple escrow vouchers in a single operation. - Key Feature: Accepts an array of voucher identifiers for batch deletion. - Use Case: Removing multiple outdated or unnecessary escrow payments efficiently. ## **Key Concepts** - **RecID**: A unique identifier for each escrow voucher, used across all operations for specific voucher identification. - **LoanRecID**: Identifies the loan associated with escrow vouchers in various operations. - **PayeeRecID**: Identifies the payee for each escrow voucher. - **Frequency**: Specifies the recurrence pattern of escrow payments (e.g., monthly, yearly). ## **API Interactions** - Use POSTNewEscrowVoucher or POSTNewEscrowVouchers (Bulk) to create new escrow vouchers, which generates new RecIDs. - Use GETGetEscrowVouchers to retrieve all vouchers for an account, obtaining RecIDs for each voucher. - Use POSTFindEscrowVouchers to search for specific vouchers across multiple criteria. - Use POSTUpdateEscrowVoucher or POSTUpdateEscrowVouchers (Bulk) with RecIDs to modify existing vouchers. - Use GETDeleteEscrowVoucher or POSTDeleteEscrowVouchers (Bulk) with RecIDs to remove vouchers from the system. - The RecIDs returned by creation operations can be immediately used with other APIs to verify, retrieve, update, or delete the vouchers.

This API enables users to delete a specific insurance record by making a GET request. The RecID of the insurance record to be deleted must be specified in the URL. Upon successful execution, the API returns a status code of 200 and a response object indicating the operation's success.

### **Usage Notes**

- The `RecId` in the URL must correspond to an existing insurance record in the system.
    
- This operation permanently removes the insurance record and cannot be undone.
    
- Despite being a delete operation, this API uses a GET request. Users should be aware of this when integrating with the system.

item.description: This folder contains documentation for APIs to manage insurance information related to loans and properties. These APIs enable comprehensive insurance operations, allowing you to create, retrieve, update, and delete insurance records efficiently. ## **API Descriptions** - **POSTNewInsurance** - Purpose: Creates a new insurance record for a specific loan and property. - Key Feature: Allows specification of detailed insurance information including policy details, agent information, and coverage amount. - Use Case: Adding a new insurance policy when a borrower purchases new coverage or changes insurance providers. - **GETGetInsurances** - Purpose: Retrieves all insurance records associated with a specific property. - Key Feature: Returns a list of insurance records, including policy details and coverage information. - Use Case: Reviewing all insurance policies related to a particular property. - **POSTUpdateInsurance** - Purpose: Updates an existing insurance record with new information. - Key Feature: Allows modification of insurance details such as policy information, coverage amount, or expiration date. - Use Case: Updating insurance information when a policy is renewed or changed. - **GETDeleteInsurance** - Purpose: Deletes a single insurance record from the system. - Key Feature: Removes the specified insurance record using its unique identifier. - Use Case: Removing an outdated or cancelled insurance policy from the system. ## **Key Concepts** - **RecID**: A unique identifier for each insurance record, used across all operations for specific insurance identification. - **LoanRecID**: Identifies the loan associated with the insurance in various operations. - **PropRecID**: Identifies the property covered by the insurance policy. - **PolicyNumber**: Unique identifier for the insurance policy itself. - **Coverage**: The monetary amount of coverage provided by the insurance policy. - **ExpirationDate**: The date when the current insurance policy expires. ## **API Interactions** - Use POSTNewInsurance to create a new insurance record, which generates a new RecID. - Use GETGetInsurances to retrieve all insurance records for a property, obtaining RecIDs for each insurance record. - Use POSTUpdateInsurance with a RecID to modify existing insurance information. - Use GETDeleteInsurance with a RecID to remove an insurance record from the system. - The RecIDs returned by creation or retrieval operations can be immediately used with other APIs to verify, update, or delete the insurance records.

This API enables users to retrieve a list of lenders and vendors that have been updated within a specific time range by making a GET request. The From and To dates should be included in the URL path. The response contains detailed information about each lender/vendor updated within the specified timeframe. ### **Usage Notes** - The `From` and `To` parameters in the URL must be replaced with valid date strings. - Dates should be in the format MM-DD-YYYY. - The response is paginated. Use the `Offset` and `PageSize` headers to control pagination. ### Request URL Field The request should include the following parameters in the request URL: | Field Name | Data Type | Description | Enum Values | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | From | string | FromDate and time to be search for get the record from Lender/Vendor. For example: 11-26-2024 07:00. If time is omitted then 00:00 will be used for filter. | \- | | To | string | ToDate and to be search for get the record from Lender/Vendor. For example: 11-26-2024 17:00. | \- | ### Response Field The response will contain an array of Lender/Vendor details. | Field Name | Description | Data Type | Enum Values | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `RecID` | Unique record to identify a Lender/Vendor | String | \- | | `Account` | Account number for a Lender/Vendor | String | \- | | `Salutation` | Salutation for a Lender/Vendor | String | \- | | `FullName` | Fullname for a Lender/Vendor | String | \- | | `FirstName` | FirstName for a Lender/Vendor | String | \- | | `MI` | MI for a Lender/Vendor | String | \- | | `LastName` | LastName for a Lender/Vendor | String | \- | | `Street` | Street for a Lender/Vendor | String | \- | | `City` | City for a Lender/Vendor | String | \- | | `State` | State for a Lender/Vendor | String | \- | | `ZipCode` | ZipCode for a Lender/Vendor | String | \- | | `PhoneHome` | Phone Numner of Home for a Lender/Vendor | String | \- | | `PhoneWork` | Phone Numner of Work for a Lender/Vendor | String | \- | | `PhoneCell` | Phone Numner for a Lender/Vendor | String | \- | | `PhoneFax` | Phone Numner of Fax for a Lender/Vendor | String | \- | | `TIN` | TIN Numner for a Lender/Vendor | String | \- | | `TINType` | TIN Type for a Lender/Vendor | String or ENUM | 0 - Unknown

item.description: This folder contains documentation for APIs to manage lender and vendor information. These APIs enable comprehensive lender and vendor operations, allowing you to create, retrieve, update, and delete lender and vendor records efficiently. ## **API Descriptions** - **POSTNewLender** - Purpose: Creates a new lender or vendor record in the system. - Key Feature: Allows specification of detailed lender/vendor information including contact details, financial information, and custom fields. - Use Case: Adding a new lender or vendor to the system for loan servicing or other business operations. - **GETGetLenders** - Purpose: Retrieves a list of all lenders and vendors in the system. - Key Feature: Returns comprehensive details for each lender/vendor, including custom fields and ACH information. - Use Case: Generating reports or populating dropdown menus with lender/vendor options. - **GETGetLendersByTimestamp** - Purpose: Retrieves lenders and vendors updated within a specific date range. - Key Feature: Allows filtering of lender/vendor records based on their last update timestamp. - Use Case: Synchronizing lender/vendor data with external systems or auditing recent changes. - **GETGetLender** - Purpose: Retrieves detailed information about a specific lender or vendor. - Key Feature: Returns comprehensive details for a single lender/vendor based on their account number. - Use Case: Displaying or verifying lender/vendor information in user interfaces. - **GETGetLenderPortfolio** - Purpose: Retrieves portfolio details for a specific lender. - Key Feature: Returns an array of loan details associated with the specified lender. - Use Case: Analyzing a lender's loan portfolio or generating lender-specific reports. - **POSTUpdateLender** - Purpose: Updates an existing lender or vendor record with new information. - Key Feature: Allows modification of lender/vendor details, including contact information, financial data, and custom fields. - Use Case: Updating lender/vendor information when details change or correcting errors. - **GETDeleteVendor** - Purpose: Deletes a vendor record from the system. - Key Feature: Removes the specified vendor using its account number. - Use Case: Removing outdated or inactive vendors from the system. - **GETDeleteLender** - Purpose: Deletes a lender record from the system. - Key Feature: Removes the specified lender using its account number. - Use Case: Removing lenders who are no longer associated with any active loans. ## **Key Concepts** - **Account**: A unique identifier for each lender or vendor, used across all operations for specific lender/vendor identification. - **RecID**: An internal unique identifier for each lender/vendor record. - **TIN**: Tax Identification Number, used for tax reporting purposes. - **ACH Information**: Banking details used for electronic fund transfers. - **Custom Fields**: Additional fields that can be defined for lenders/vendors to capture organization-specific information. ## **API Interactions** - Use POSTNewLender to create a new lender or vendor record, which generates a new Account number. - Use GETGetLenders or GETGetLendersByTimestamp to retrieve lists of lenders/vendors, obtaining Account numbers for each. - Use GETGetLender with an Account number to retrieve detailed information about a specific lender/vendor. - Use GETGetLenderPortfolio with a lender's Account number to retrieve their loan portfolio details. - Use POSTUpdateLender with an Account number to modify existing lender/vendor information. - Use GETDeleteVendor or GETDeleteLender with an Account number to remove a vendor or lender from the system.

item.description: This folder contains documentation for APIs to manage attachments associated with lenders. These APIs enable comprehensive attachment operations, allowing you to retrieve attachment metadata and content efficiently. ## **API Descriptions** - **GETGetLenderAttachment** - Purpose: Retrieves detailed information and content for a specific lender attachment. - Key Feature: Returns comprehensive details about the attachment, including the actual document content as a byte array. - Use Case: Downloading or viewing a specific document associated with a lender. - **GETGetLenderAttachments** - Purpose: Retrieves a list of all attachments associated with a specific lender. - Key Feature: Returns metadata for all attachments linked to the specified lender, without including the actual document content. - Use Case: Displaying a list of available documents for a lender in a user interface or generating reports on lender documentation. ## **Key Concepts** - **RecID**: A unique identifier for each attachment, used across all operations for specific attachment identification. - **LenderRecID**: Identifies the lender associated with the attachments. - **OwnerType**: Specifies the type of entity that owns the attachment (e.g., Lender, Borrower, Vendor). - **DocType**: Categorizes the type of document (e.g., Statement, Unknown). - **Publish**: Indicates whether the attachment is published or not. ## **API Interactions** - Use GETGetLenderAttachments with a `LenderRecID` **(this can be obtained using the GetLenders call in the Lender/Vendor module)** to retrieve a list of all attachments for a specific lender, obtaining RecIDs for each attachment. - Use GETGetLenderAttachment with an AttachmentRecID to retrieve detailed information and content for a specific attachment. - The RecIDs obtained from GETGetLenderAttachments can be used with GETGetLenderAttachment to retrieve the full content of individual attachments.

| `To` | string | ToDate to be search for get the record from Lender/Vendor History | \- |

item.description: This folder contains documentation for APIs to manage and retrieve historical transaction data related to lenders and vendors. These APIs enable comprehensive historical data operations, allowing you to access detailed transaction histories efficiently. ## **API Descriptions** - **GETGetLenderHistory** - Purpose: Retrieves the transaction history for a specific lender or vendor within a given date range. - Key Feature: Returns an array of detailed transaction records, including payment information, loan details, and ACH data. - Use Case: Generating transaction reports, auditing lender accounts, or reviewing historical loan performance. ## **Key Concepts** - **LenderAccount**: A unique identifier for each lender or vendor, obtained from the GetLenders call in the Lender/Vendor Module. - **Date Range**: Specified by From and To dates, allowing targeted historical data retrieval. - **Transaction Types**: Various transaction types are recorded, including regular payments, late charges, prepayments, etc. - **Loan Balance**: Each transaction record includes the loan balance after the transaction, providing a snapshot of the loan status at that point in time. - **ACH Information**: For transactions processed through ACH, additional details such as batch numbers and trace numbers are included. ## **API Interactions** - Use GETGetLenderHistory with a LenderAccount and date range to retrieve a comprehensive transaction history for a specific lender or vendor. - The LenderAccount used in this API is obtained from the GetLenders call in the Lender/Vendor Module, demonstrating the interconnected nature of these modules. - The detailed transaction data returned can be used for various downstream processes such as reporting, analysis, or integration with other financial systems. This module is crucial for maintaining a complete and accurate record of all financial transactions related to lenders and vendors in a loan servicing or mortgage origination system. It provides a detailed view of historical data, which is essential for: 1. Compliance and auditing purposes 2. Resolving disputes or discrepancies 3. Analyzing lender or loan performance over time 4. Generating accurate financial reports 5. Supporting customer service inquiries about historical transactions

This API enables users to retrieve a list of loans by making a GET request. It returns comprehensive information about multiple loans in the system.

### **Usage Notes**

- This endpoint does not require a request body.
    
- The response is paginated. Use the `Offset` and `PageSize` headers to control pagination.
    

### Response

- `Data` (string): Response Data (Array of Loan information objects)
    
- `ErrorMessage` (string): Error message, if any
    
- `ErrorNumber` (integer): Error number
    
- `Status` (integer): Status of the request
    

The response returns a status code of 200 upon successful execution.

This API enables users to retrieve a list of loans updated within a specific date range by making a GET request. The date range should be included in the URL path.

### **Usage Notes**

- The From and To dates in the URL path must be in a format recognized by the system (MM-DD-YYYY HH:MI). For example: 11-26-2024 07:00. If time is omitted then 00:00 will be used for filter.
    
- The response is paginated. Use the `Offset` and `PageSize` headers to control pagination.
    

### Response

- `Data` (string): Response Data (Array of Loan information objects)
    
- `ErrorMessage` (string): Error message, if any
    
- `ErrorNumber` (integer): Error number
    
- `Status` (integer)
    

The response returns a status code of 200 upon successful execution.

request.description:
This API enables users to retrieve detailed information about a specific loan by making a GET request. The loan account number should be included in the URL path.

### **Usage Notes**

- The Account in the URL path must correspond to an existing loan account in the system.
    
- This endpoint returns comprehensive information about the loan, including borrower details, loan terms, and additional settings.
    
- It supports various types of loans, including conventional loans, adjustable-rate mortgages (ARMs), and lines of credit.
    

### Response

The response will be contain Loan object in JSON form.

request.description:
This API enables users to update an existing loan's information by making a POST request. The updated loan details should be provided in the request body.

### **Usage Notes**

- The Account field in the request body must correspond to an existing loan account in the system.
    
- All fields in the request body will overwrite the existing data for the specified loan.
    

### Request Body

The request should include a JSON payload of the Loan Object.

**Note:** This endpoint requires the complete loan object to be submitted. Any fields not included in the request will be interpreted as null and their existing values will be deleted. To avoid data loss, ensure all relevant loan fields are included in the payload.

### Response

- `Data` (string): Response Data.
    
- `ErrorMessage` (string): Error message, if any
    
- `ErrorNumber` (integer): Error number
    
- `Status` (integer): Status of the request
    

The response returns a status code of 200 upon successful execution.

request.description:
This API enables users to delete a specific loan by making a GET request. The loan account number should be included in the URL path.

### **Usage Notes**

- The Account in the URL path must correspond to an existing loan account in the system.
    
- The Account number can be obtained via the GetLoan call.
    
- This operation permanently removes the loan record and cannot be undone.
    

### Response

- `Data` (string): Response data
    
- `ErrorMessage` (string): Error message, if any
    
- `ErrorNumber` (integer): Error number
    
- `Status` (integer): Status of the request
    

The response returns a status code of 200 upon successful execution.

item.description:
This folder contains documentation for APIs to manage loan information. These APIs enable comprehensive loan operations, allowing you to create, retrieve, update, and delete loan records efficiently. ## **API Descriptions** - **POSTNewLoan** - Purpose: Creates a new loan record in the system. - Key Feature: Allows specification of detailed loan information including borrower details, loan terms, and custom fields. - Use Case: Adding a new loan during loan origination or when onboarding a new loan to the system. - **GETGetLoans** - Purpose: Retrieves a list of all loans in the system. - Key Feature: Returns comprehensive details for each loan, with support for pagination. - Use Case: Generating reports or populating dashboards with loan information. - **GETGetLoansByTimestamp** - Purpose: Retrieves loans that were created or updated within a specific date range. - Key Feature: Allows filtering of loan records based on their last update timestamp. - Use Case: Syncing loan data with external systems or auditing recent changes. - **GETGetLoan** - Purpose: Retrieves detailed information about a specific loan. - Key Feature: Returns comprehensive details for a single loan based on its account number. - Use Case: Displaying or verifying loan information in user interfaces. - **POSTUpdateLoan** - Purpose: Updates an existing loan record with new information. - Key Feature: Allows modification of loan details, including borrower information, loan terms, and custom fields. - Use Case: Updating loan information when terms change or correcting errors in loan data. - **GETDeleteLoan** - Purpose: Deletes a loan record from the system. - Key Feature: Removes the specified loan using its account number. - Use Case: Removing loans that were created in error or are no longer active. ## **Key Concepts** - **Account**: A unique identifier for each loan, used across all operations for specific loan identification. - **PrimaryBorrower**: Information about the main borrower associated with the loan. - **Terms**: Detailed loan terms including interest rates, payment schedules, and maturity dates. - **CustomFields**: Additional fields that can be defined for loans to capture organization-specific information. ## **API Interactions** - Use POSTNewLoan to create a new loan record, which generates a new Account number. - Use GETGetLoans or GETGetLoansByTimestamp to retrieve lists of loans, obtaining Account numbers for each. - Use GETGetLoan with an Account number to retrieve detailed information about a specific loan. - Use POSTUpdateLoan with an Account number to modify existing loan information. - Use GETDeleteLoan with an Account number to remove a loan from the system. # Loan Object Fields Glossary #### **Loan Information - item.description: This folder contains documentation for APIs to manage attachments associated with loans. These APIs enable comprehensive attachment operations, allowing you to create, retrieve, and manage loan-related documents efficiently. ## **API Descriptions** - **POSTAddLSAttachment** - Purpose: Creates a new attachment for a specific loan. - Key Feature: Allows uploading of file content along with metadata such as file name, description, and document type. - Use Case: Adding new documents or files to an existing loan record, such as payment statements or audit reports. - **GETGetLoanAttachments** - Purpose: Retrieves a list of all attachments associated with a specific loan. - Key Feature: Returns metadata for all attachments linked to the specified loan, without including the actual document content. - Use Case: Displaying a list of available documents for a loan in a user interface or generating reports on loan documentation. - **GETGetLoanAttachment** - Purpose: Retrieves detailed information and content for a specific loan attachment. - Key Feature: Returns comprehensive details about the attachment, including the actual document content as a byte array. - Use Case: Downloading or viewing a specific document associated with a loan. ## **Key Concepts** - **LoanNumber**: A unique identifier for each loan, used to associate attachments with specific loans. This is obtained in the GetLoan, GetLoans or GetLoansByTimestamp calls from the Loan Module. - **Account:** Account number associated with a loan. This is obtained in the GetLoan, GetLoans or GetLoansByTimestamp calls from the Loan Module - **AttachmentRecID**: A unique identifier for each attachment, used for retrieving specific attachment details. - **DocType**: Categorizes the type of document (e.g., Statement, Unknown). - **Publish**: Indicates whether the attachment is published or not. - **Content**: The actual file content, typically stored and transmitted as a Base64 encoded string. ## **API Interactions** - Use POSTAddLSAttachment to create a new attachment for a loan, which generates a new AttachmentRecID. `LoanNumber` should be used to determine which loan is being attached with this Attachment - Use GETGetLoanAttachments with a `Account` to retrieve a list of all attachments for a specific loan, obtaining AttachmentRecIDs for each attachment. - Use GETGetLoanAttachment with an `AttachmentRecID` to retrieve detailed information and content for a specific attachment. - The `AttachmentRecIDs` obtained from GETGetLoanAttachments or POSTAddLSAttachment can be used with GETGetLoanAttachment to retrieve the full content of individual attachments.

item.description: This folder contains documentation for APIs to manage loan charges associated with specific loans. These APIs enable comprehensive loan charge operations, allowing you to create, retrieve, and update loan charges efficiently. ## **API Descriptions** - **POSTNewLoanCharge** - Purpose: Creates a new loan charge for a specific loan. - Key Feature: Allows specification of detailed charge information including amount, interest rate, and associated lenders/vendors. - Use Case: Adding new charges to a loan, such as appraisal fees, doc fees, or other loan-related expenses. - **POSTUpdateLoanCharge** - Purpose: Updates an existing loan charge with new information. - Key Feature: Allows modification of charge details such as amounts, dates, and associated information. - Use Case: Adjusting charge details due to changes in fees, corrections, or updates to charge information. - **GETGetLoanCharges** - Purpose: Retrieves all loan charges associated with a specific loan account. - Key Feature: Returns an array of detailed charge records for the specified loan. - Use Case: Reviewing all charges associated with a loan for accounting, auditing, or customer service purposes. ## **Key Concepts** - **ParentRecID**: A unique identifier for the parent loan to which the charge is associated. This is obtained via the GetLoans, GetLoan or GetLoansByTimestamp APIs found in the Loan Module. - **RecID**: A unique identifier for each loan charge, used for updating specific charges. - **OwedToRecID/OwedByRecID**: Identifiers for lenders/vendors involved in the charge, indicating who is owed the charge or who owes it. This can be obtained via the GetLenders/GetVendors API calls found in the Lender/Vendor module. - **ChargeType**: Categorizes the type of charge (e.g., Appraisal Fee, Doc Fee). - **Deferred**: Indicates whether the charge is deferred or not. - **AssessFinanceCharges**: Determines if finance charges should be assessed on this charge. - **Account:** Account number of the loan to which Loan Charges are being retrieved for. This is obtained via the GetLoans, GetLoan or GetLoansByTimestamp APIs found in the Loan Module. ## **API Interactions** - Use POSTNewLoanCharge to create a new charge for a loan, which generates a new `RecID` for the charge. - Use GETGetLoanCharges with a loan `Account` number to retrieve all charges associated with that loan, obtaining `RecIDs` for each charge. - Use POSTUpdateLoanCharge with a Loan Charge `RecID` to modify existing charge information.

item.description: This folder contains documentation for APIs to manage funding operations related to loans. These APIs enable comprehensive funding operations, allowing you to add new fundings, retrieve funding details, and manage funding history efficiently. ## **API Descriptions** - **POSTAddFunding** - Purpose: Adds a new funding to a specific loan. - Key Feature: Allows specification of detailed funding information including amount, lender details, and associated fees. - Use Case: Recording a new funding draw on a loan. - **POSTAddFundings** - Purpose: Adds multiple new fundings, potentially across different loans. - Key Feature: Accepts an array of funding details, enabling efficient batch funding operations. - Use Case: Processing multiple funding transactions in a single operation, such as during a bulk loan funding event. - **POSTAddFundingsAsync** - Purpose: Asynchronously adds multiple new fundings. - Key Feature: Allows for non-blocking addition of multiple fundings, ideal for large batch operations. - Use Case: Adding a large number of fundings without waiting for immediate completion. - **GETGetLoanFunding** - Purpose: Retrieves detailed funding information for a specific loan. - Key Feature: Returns comprehensive details about all fundings associated with a loan. - Use Case: Reviewing the current funding state of a loan, including lender information and disbursement details. - **GETGetFundingHistory** - Purpose: Retrieves the funding history for a specific loan. - Key Feature: Provides a chronological list of funding transactions for a loan. - Use Case: Auditing the funding activities on a loan over time. - **GETGetFundingStatus** - Purpose: Checks the status of a specific funding operation. - Key Feature: Returns the current status of a funding transaction, particularly useful for asynchronous operations. - Use Case: Monitoring the progress of a funding operation initiated through AddFundingsAsync. - **GETGetLoanFundingHistory** - Purpose: Retrieves detailed funding history for a loan. - Key Feature: Provides in-depth information about each funding transaction in a loan's history. - Use Case: Conducting a detailed review of all funding activities on a loan, including creation details and notes. ## **Key Concepts** - **LoanAccount/LoanRecID**: Identifies the loan being funded. Obtained from the Loan module. - **LenderAccount/LenderRecID**: Identifies the lender providing the funding. Obtained from the Lender/Vendor module. - **FundingRecID**: A unique identifier for each funding transaction. - **Amount**: The monetary value of the funding transaction. - **TransDate**: The date when the funding transaction occurred. - **DrawType**: Categorizes the type of funding transaction (e.g., Funding, Paydown, Transfer, WriteOff). - **Disbursements**: Details of how the funded amount is distributed or allocated. ## **API Interactions** - Use POSTAddFunding or POSTAddFundings to create new funding records, which generates new FundingRecIDs. - Use POSTAddFundingsAsync for large batch funding operations, followed by GETGetFundingStatus to check completion. - Use GETGetLoanFunding with a LoanAccount to retrieve current funding details for a loan. - Use GETGetFundingHistory or GETGetLoanFundingHistory with a LoanAccount to retrieve historical funding information. - The LoanAccount/LoanRecID used in these APIs is typically obtained from the Loan module via APIs like GetLoan or GetLoans. - The LenderAccount/LenderRecID used is typically obtained from the Lender/Vendor module via APIs like GetLenders or GetVendors.

item.description: This folder contains documentation for APIs to manage and retrieve historical transaction data related to loans. These APIs enable comprehensive historical data operations, allowing you to add new history entries, retrieve detailed history for specific loans, and access historical data across multiple loans efficiently. ## **API Descriptions** - **POSTAddLoanHistory** - Purpose: Adds a new history entry to a specific loan. - Key Feature: Allows specification of detailed transaction information including payment allocations, ACH details, and various fee applications. - Use Case: Recording a new payment or transaction on a loan. - **GETGetLoanHistory** - Purpose: Retrieves the complete history for a specific loan. - Key Feature: Returns a chronological list of all transactions and events for a given loan account. - Use Case: Reviewing the full transaction history of a particular loan. - **GETGetLoanBillingHistory** - Purpose: Retrieves the billing history for a specific loan. - Key Feature: Provides detailed billing information including APR, balance changes, and payment allocations. - Use Case: Analyzing the billing and payment patterns for a specific loan over time. - **GETGetAllLoanHistory** - Purpose: Retrieves loan history for all loans within a specified date range. - Key Feature: Allows retrieval of transaction data across multiple loans for a given time period. - Use Case: Generating reports or auditing transactions across the entire loan portfolio. - **GETGetAllLoanHistoryByCreatedDate** - Purpose: Retrieves loan history for all loans based on the creation date of the history records. - Key Feature: Focuses on when history entries were created rather than when transactions occurred. - Use Case: Tracking recent changes or additions to loan history across all loans. ## **Key Concepts** - **LoanAccount/LoanRecID**: Identifies the specific loan for which history is being added or retrieved. - **DateRec/DateDue**: Dates associated with transactions, used for chronological ordering and filtering. - **PayMethod**: Indicates the method used for payments (e.g., ACH, Check, Cash). - **Transaction Allocations**: Various 'To' fields (e.g., ToPrincipal, ToInterest) showing how payments are allocated. - **ACH Details**: Information related to Automated Clearing House transactions. - **SourceApp/SourceTyp**: Indicates the origin of the transaction within the system. ## **API Interactions** - Use POSTAddLoanHistory to create new history entries for a loan, which may generate new RecIDs for each entry. - Use GETGetLoanHistory with a LoanAccount to retrieve the complete history for a specific loan. - Use GETGetLoanBillingHistory with a LoanAccount to retrieve detailed billing history for a loan. - Use GETGetAllLoanHistory with date parameters to retrieve history across all loans for a specific time period. - Use GETGetAllLoanHistoryByCreatedDate to retrieve recently added history entries across all loans. - The LoanAccount/LoanRecID used in these APIs is typically obtained from the Loan module via APIs like GetLoan or GetLoans.

item.description: This folder contains documentation for APIs to manage property information related to loans. These APIs enable comprehensive property operations, allowing you to create, retrieve, update, and delete property records efficiently. ## **API Descriptions** - **POSTNewProperty** - Purpose: Creates a new property record associated with a specific loan. - Key Feature: Allows specification of detailed property information including address, appraisal details, and lien information. - Use Case: Adding a new property as collateral for a loan or updating property records during loan origination. - **GETGetLoanProperties** - Purpose: Retrieves all property records associated with a specific loan. - Key Feature: Returns comprehensive details for each property linked to the loan, including lien information. - Use Case: Reviewing all properties associated with a loan for underwriting or servicing purposes. - **GETGetLoanLiens** - Purpose: Retrieves lien information for properties associated with a specific loan. - Key Feature: Provides detailed lien data including holder, amounts, and last checked date. - Use Case: Assessing the lien position and total obligations on properties linked to a loan. - **POSTUpdateProperty** - Purpose: Updates an existing property record with new information. - Key Feature: Allows modification of property details such as appraisal information, occupancy status, or lien details. - Use Case: Updating property information after a new appraisal or change in property status. - **GETDeleteProperty** - Purpose: Deletes a property record from the system. - Key Feature: Removes the specified property using its unique identifier. - Use Case: Removing a property that is no longer associated with a loan or correcting erroneously added property records. ## **Key Concepts** - **LoanRecID**: A unique identifier for the loan associated with the property. - **RecID**: A unique identifier for each property record. - **APN**: Assessor's Parcel Number, a unique identifier for the property in public records. - **AppraiserFMV**: Fair Market Value as determined by an appraiser. - **LTV**: Loan-to-Value ratio, indicating the loan amount in relation to the property value. - **Liens**: Information about existing liens on the property, which may affect the loan's position and risk. - **Occupancy**: The intended use of the property (e.g., owner-occupied, investment). - **Primary**: Indicates whether this is the primary property associated with the loan. ## **API Interactions** - Use POSTNewProperty to create a new property record, which generates a new RecID. - Use GETGetLoanProperties with a LoanRecID to retrieve all properties associated with a specific loan. - Use GETGetLoanLiens with a LoanAccount to retrieve lien information for properties linked to a loan. - Use POSTUpdateProperty with a RecID to modify existing property information. - Use GETDeleteProperty with a RecID to remove a property record from the system. - The LoanRecID used in these APIs is typically obtained from the Loan module via APIs like GetLoan or GetLoans.

request.description:
This API enables users to retrieve the impound balance for a specific loan account by making a GET request. The loan account number should be included in the URL path. Upon successful execution, the API returns the current impound balance for the specified loan.

### **Usage Notes**

- The Account in the URL path must correspond to an existing loan account in the system.
    
- This endpoint does not require a request body.
    
- The impound balance represents funds held in escrow for expenses such as property taxes or insurance.
    

### Response

- `Data` (number): Response Data (The loan impound balance)
    
- `ErrorMessage` (string): Error message, if any
    
- `ErrorNumber` (integer): Error number
    
- `Status` (integer): Status of the request
    

The response returns a status code of 200 upon successful execution.

item.description: This folder contains documentation for APIs to manage custom fields for various entities such as loans, lenders, vendors, and more. These APIs provide full control over the creation, retrieval, updating, and deletion of custom fields, enabling users to customize their data model to suit specific business needs. ## API Descriptions - **POST NewCustomField** - **Purpose**: Creates a new custom field associated with a specific tab and owner type. - **Key Feature**: Allows the definition of field characteristics such as data type, format, and predefined lists (PickList). - **Use Case**: Adding a custom field to capture specific data points for loans, lenders, or other entities in your system. - **GET DeleteCustomField** - **Purpose**: Deletes an existing custom field using its unique identifier. - **Key Feature**: Removes the specified custom field from the system permanently. - **Use Case**: Removing outdated or incorrect custom fields no longer relevant to business operations. ## Key Concepts - **RecID**: A unique identifier for each custom field record in the system. - **TabRecID**: A unique identifier for the tab under which the custom field is grouped. - **TabName**: The name of the tab that contains the custom field. - **OwnerType**: Enum representing the type of owner entity (e.g., Loan, Lender, Vendor) for which the custom field is created. - **DataType**: Specifies the type of data the custom field can hold (e.g., Text, Currency, Date). - **PickList**: A predefined list of values from which the user can select when interacting with the custom field. - **Sequence**: The order in which the custom field appears in the UI. ## API Interactions - Use **POST NewCustomField** to create a new custom field, defining its name, data type, and format. The custom field will be associated with a specific entity type (e.g., loan, lender) and appear under the specified tab. - Use **GET DeleteCustomField** with the **RecID** to delete an existing custom field from the system. The **RecID** and **TabRecID** used in these APIs are typically generated when the custom field is first created or retrieved using related APIs in the Custom Fields module.

request.description:
This API enables users to add a new conversation entry for a specified parent entity (loan, lender, etc.) by making a POST request. The conversation details should be provided in the request body.

### Usage Notes

- **`ParentRecID`** must correspond to an existing parent record in the system obtained from a related module (such as GetLoan or GetLender).
    
- All required fields must be included in the request body.
    
- Dates should be provided in `MM/DD/YYYY` format.
    

### Request Body

| Field Name | Description | Data Type | Enum Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ParentRecID | Required. Unique Parent record to identify a Conversations | String | NA |
| ParentType | Required. Refers to the category or classification of a parent record | Enum | Unknown = 0 LOSLoan = 1 TDSLoan =2 TDSLender =3 TDSVendor =4 PSSPartner=5 PSSTrustee= 6 MBSPartner= 7 CMOHolder= 8 LastEntry= 9 LOSLender =10 TFAPayer = 11 TFAPayee= 12 TFAClient = 13 |
| CallDate | Required. Specific date on which a call or communication took place. | DateTime | NA |
| CallType | Required. Nature of the call, such as Incoming, Outgoing. | Enum | Incoming = 0 Outgoing = 1 |
| CallPerson | The individual involved in or responsible for the call | String | NA |
| Subject | The main topic or focus of the communication. | String | NA |
| MemoText | Refers to additional notes | String | NA |
| Publish | Refers to the action of making information, such as a document or data | String | NA |
| FollowUp | Refers to an action or communication intended to continue | String | NA |
| FollowUpName | Refers to the name or title associated with a follow-up action | String | NA |
| FollowUpDate | Refers to the scheduled date | DateTime | NA |
| Completed | Process has been finished | String | NA |
| CompletedName | The name of a finished task or action. | String | NA |
| CompletedDate | The date on which a task or action was finished. | DateTime | NA |

### Response

- `Data` (string): Response data
    
- `ErrorMessage` (string): Error message, if any
    
- `ErrorNumber` (integer): Error number
    
- `Status` (integer): Status of the request
    

The response returns a status code of 200 upon successful execution.

| CompletedName | The name of a finished task or action. | String | NA |
| CompletedDate | The date on which a task or action was finished. | DateTime | NA |

### Response

- `Data`(string): Response data
    
- `ErrorMessage` (string): Error message, if any
    
- `ErrorNumber`(integer): Error number
    
- `Status`(integer): Status of the request
    

The response returns a status code of 200 upon successful execution.

item.description: This folder contains documentation for APIs that manage loan conversations associated with specific loan accounts. These APIs provide functionality for creating, updating, retrieving, and managing conversations, enabling users to maintain detailed communication records related to loans. ## API Descriptions - **POST NewConversation** - **Purpose:** Creates a new loan conversation associated with a specific loan account. - **Key Feature:** Allows users to log new communications, including details such as the call date, type, and involved personnel. - **Use Case:** Initiating a record for a recent discussion with a borrower, ensuring that all pertinent information is documented from the outset. - **POST UpdateConversation** - **Purpose:** Updates an existing loan conversation with new details. - **Key Feature:** Allows the modification of conversation attributes such as call date, call type, subject, and follow-up actions. - **Use Case:** Updating a conversation record to reflect new information or changes following a recent discussion with a borrower. - **GET GetLoanConversations** - **Purpose:** Retrieves all conversations associated with a specific loan account. - **Key Feature:** Provides a complete history of communications, facilitating easy access to past interactions. - **Use Case:** A loan officer can review all conversations related to a loan account to ensure they have the latest information before contacting the borrower. ## Key Concepts - **RecID:** A unique identifier for each conversation record in the system. - **ParentRecID:** The unique identifier for the parent record associated with the conversation. - **CallDate:** The date and time when the communication occurred. - **CallType:** Enum representing the nature of the call (e.g., Incoming, Outgoing). - **CallPerson:** The individual involved in the conversation. - **Subject:** The primary topic discussed during the conversation. - **MemoText:** Additional notes related to the conversation for context. - **FollowUp:** Indicates whether a follow-up action is needed after the conversation. - **Completed:** Indicates if the conversation has been resolved or finalized. ## API Interactions - Use **POST NewConversation** to log a new communication regarding a loan account, capturing all necessary details from the outset. - Use **POST UpdateConversation** to modify an existing conversation's details, ensuring that all relevant information is up-to-date and accurately documented. - Use **GET GetLoanConversations** to retrieve all conversation records associated with a specific loan account, allowing users to review and analyze communication history. - The **RecID** and **ParentRecID** used in these APIs are typically generated when a conversation is first created or retrieved using related APIs in the Loan Conversation Module.
